answer: The frozen catalogue links Design code, Design code area and Design code rule to the National Planning Policy Framework through three inferred derived-from-policy links. These links provide a route to source material for further investigation. They do not assess a particular proposal, establish current policy wording or prove compliance. The same qualification applies to all 40 rule-derived links in this bundle.
limitations: The source snapshot is dated 25 July 2026. The review date of 25 October 2026 is overdue and has not been extended by format migration.
All 230 concepts are draft records. They have not been recorded as human-verified; source endorsement is not claimed.
The 40 domain links are inferred deterministic collection rules. They are not OKF Core assertions or qualified Bundle Wiki assertions.
The 34,391,082 entity figure is catalogue metadata, not a count independently acquired or verified by this pilot.
Per-record rights and attribution apply. MCP bindings describe discovery metadata and do not provide executable services or access permission.
negative_controls: Do not conclude that a proposal complies with the NPPF from a derived-from-policy link.
Do not treat a July snapshot as current policy or a November format migration as source review.
Do not interpret a dataset record, entity count or MCP binding as permission, live availability or executable access.
